mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average for three consecutive months, market expectations for future rate hikes diminish, lowering discount rates and boosting the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < avg(FEDFUNDS) over the past 12 months for three consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 12-month pre-signal baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in low-rate regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by rising consumer confidence (HOUST) simultaneously lowers real interest rates via wage-price feedback and boosts business investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above its 3-month moving average AND HOUST > 10th percentile of its 6-month rolling distribution
failure_condition: In regimes with strong labor growth but weak consumer confidence, 20-day forward returns are negative or no better than random chance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness that raises uncertainty and dampens equity valuation, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods of high uncertainty (e.g., high VIX proxies not available), INDPRO contraction does not produce statistically significant negative 5-day forward returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly exceeds the Fed's target by more than 0.5 percentage points for two consecutive months, markets anticipate tighter policy, causing a sharp discounting of equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0% and remains above for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In non-Fed tightening periods, CPIAUCSL surprise > 0.5pp does not result in statistically significant negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden, one-time decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% triggers a risk-on equity premium as investors anticipate sustained economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% in a single month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is not significantly positive after controlling for sector-specific news (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail sales (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) jointly signal labor market resilience and consumer confidence, which amplifies equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for two consecutive months AND UNRATE falls for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Strengthening labor market and consumer demand
failure_condition: In periods of high inflation or supply shocks, the interaction does not produce statistically significant positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) below trend for three months raises uncertainty about future output, which elevates risk premia and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During periods of low macro volatility, RSAFS decline does not lead to statistically significant negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS converges to the pre-pandemic level (≈1.5%), it signals a normalization of monetary policy, reducing discounting of equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, but only in non-recessionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: 3-month moving avg(FEDFUNDS) crosses above 1.5% AND recessionary indicators (e.g., INDPRO < 50) are absent for the past 6 months
failure_condition: In recessionary regimes, the policy normalization signal does not produce statistically significant positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).
